# tebib_iam_access_key (Resource)

An access key for a service account (or a user). The secret is only known when the key is created: it is stored in the Terraform state (marked sensitive), so keep the state encrypted, or create keys outside Terraform. An imported key has no secret.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tebib_iam_access_key" "ci" {
  service_account_id = tebib_iam_service_account.ci.id
  description        = "GitHub Actions"
  allowed_cidrs      = ["192.0.2.0/24"]
}

# The secret is in the state (sensitive). Hand it to the consumer, e.g. a CI secret.
output "ci_access_key_id" {
  value = tebib_iam_access_key.ci.id
}

output "ci_secret_access_key" {
  value     = tebib_iam_access_key.ci.secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `allowed_cidrs` (Set of String) Addresses the key works from (empty: anywhere). Changing them replaces the key.
- `description` (String) Description, at most 255 characters. Default: empty.
- `expires_at` (String) Expiry (RFC 3339), at most 365 days ahead. Default: 90 days after creation. Changing it replaces the key.
- `never_expires` (Boolean) A key that never expires (service accounts only; needs `iam:CreateNonExpiringAccessKey`). Changing it replaces the key.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID (`o-...`). Default: the provider's `organization`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `service_account_id` (String) Service account that owns the key. Give this or `user_id`.
- `status` (String) `active` or `inactive`. TebibHost may turn an unused key off; Terraform then sees `inactive` and turns it on again. Default: `active`.
- `user_id` (String) User that owns the key. Give this or `service_account_id`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339).
- `disables_at` (String) When TebibHost turns it off if it stays unused.
- `id` (String) Access key ID (`TBK...`).
- `last_used_at` (String) When it was last used.
- `owner` (String) TRN of the key's owner.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The secret. Only set by the create; null after an import.
- `status_reason` (String) Why TebibHost turned the key off, if it did.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) `<id>.<secret>`: what goes after `Authorization: Bearer`.
- `trn` (String) The key's TRN.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# An imported key has no secret.
terraform import tebib_iam_access_key.ci service-account/sa-abc123/TBKXYZ
terraform import tebib_iam_access_key.mine user/u-abc123/TBKXYZ
```
